enrichment_method.evidence: Biotinylated RNA was enriched using streptavidin Dynabeads, pre-washed three times in B&W buffer (5 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 0.5 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl, 0.1% Tween-20) and incubated for 2 h with 5 μL Superase-in (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Cat# AM2696).
Lysates were sonicated, clarified (16,000 rpm, 10 min, 4 °C), and incubated overnight at 4 °C with pre-washed streptavidin beads.

instrument.evidence: Samples were reconstituted in 20 μL of 2% acetonitrile with 0.1% formic acid and analyzed by nanoLC coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometry (Thermo Fisher).
